title: MotionCoach: Constructing Multimodal Guidance for Video Professional Motion Editing
abstract: arXiv:2610.12963v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video editing models achieve strong performance in modifying appearance, backgrounds, styles, and motions, empowered by large-scale training data. Beyond general scenarios, professional motions are significant in performance, sports, and martial arts. This paper focuses on professional motion editing, which involves fine-grained motion technique and temporal structure. Given professional motion names but lacking detailed descriptions, existing models often fail to generate professional motions, such as incorrectly lifting the front wheel under a Stoppie instruction. To address this challenge, we introduce MotionCoach, a trained multimodal agent that uses multi-turn tools and performs self-verification, producing a grounded prompt and a reference clip as reliable and sufficient multimodal guidance to inject external professional motion knowledge into video editing models. translated_title: MotionCoach：为视频专业动作编辑构建多模态引导
translated_abstract: 视频编辑模型在大规模训练数据的加持下，在外观、背景、风格和动作的修改方面已取得出色的表现。除一般场景外，专业动作在表演、体育和武术等领域具有重要意义。本文聚焦于专业动作编辑，这涉及细粒度的动作技巧和时间结构。在仅有专业动作名称而缺乏详细描述的情况下，现有模型往往无法生成专业动作，例如在“Stoppie（前轮翘头急刹）”指令下错误地抬起前轮。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了MotionCoach——一个经过训练的多模态智能体，它通过多轮工具调用并执行自我验证，生成接地气的提示词和参考片段，作为可靠且充分的多模态引导，将外部专业动作知识注入视频编辑模型。为提供训练数据，我们构建了一个数据管道来构造……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 提出MotionCoach——一个通过多轮工具调用与自我验证来生成接地提示词和参考片段的多模态智能体，将外部专业动作知识注入视频编辑模型，从而实现细粒度的专业动作编辑。
en_tdlr: MotionCoach, a trained multimodal agent with multi-turn tool use and self-verification, generates grounded prompts and reference clips as multimodal guidance to inject external professional motion knowledge into video editing models, enabling fine-grained professional motion editing.
